model.description: Fused 3D model: levels L1-L3 (Vp, Vs, rho, Qp, Qs, units, alteration, geology and regional inputs) and the surface layers, UTM 10N + NAVD88 (xarray DataTree, zarr v3)
model.license: CC-BY-4.0 (derived product); see docs/data_policy.md for each input
model.cite: Denolle, M. and Yao, D. (2026). rainier3d: a geology-driven 3D velocity model of Mount Rainier. https://github.com/Denolle-Lab/mt-rainier-digital-model

gnss.description: GNSS station velocities (MIDAS, QC flags), strain-rate grid and daily regional strain series (S18)
gnss.cite: as model; GPS time series provided by the Pacific Northwest Geodetic Array, Central Washington University

edifice_load.description: Stress from the weight of the edifice (Boussinesq half-space) on the model levels L1-L3 (S18)
